quests.title: Us... In the Aquarium?

dialogue.t: Yes, I see what you mean.
Look at the color of its tail. It's the most fashionable thing in the whole aquarium.
The colors are a bit loud for my taste, but alright, I'll take it as a compliment.
Whoa! Look at all these people! Is everyone here to see the fish?
Mmhmm! I just wrapped up a scene, so I'm taking time out to admire your aquarium.
What were you talking about just now?
We were trying to decide which fish looks most like Chiori.
Oh, uh, hehe... Oh well, it was actually Columbina who mentioned it originally. It sounded like fun, and then, before we knew it, we were doing it too.
Oh, look! That one's just like you, Chevreuse.
Never still, swimming laps around the tank. Just like you, training every second of the day!

quests.description: Your friends seem to be admiring the aquarium…
